core_verdict_rule: All critical acceptance items PASS on the exact target deployment and no open P0/P1.

items.oracle: Required control files exist; DAG is acyclic; source/config syntax and local evidence are valid.

A new user registers through a provider-neutral standard SMTP path, receives and consumes verification mail, logs in, requests and consumes one-time password reset; expired/reused token fails. NitroSend is neither required nor accepted.
User B cannot read User A recommendation, pack, export, resume, profile or events; attempts return non-disclosing 404/denial.
Platform Secret is configured server-side, hidden from users/exports, bounded by per-user/platform budget, and deterministic fallback remains usable on failure.
After resume upload and one confirmation page, recommendations appear without manually pasting a job URL.
Configured refresh is exactly 6 hours and each completed run sets next_discovery_at to completed_at + 6 hours.
All forms, buttons, inputs and links are wired; city/role/skill/source/freshness/qualification/relevance/opportunity/status filters compose; mobile has no horizontal overflow.
Save/ignore, application pack, official link, manual import and result tracking work; submitted status requires evidence.
PostgreSQL is at Alembic head; v0.2 data counts and Owner records are preserved and readable after migration.
Encrypted backup is structurally readable; application restart preserves data; an explicit rollback image exists.
tests: isolated restore or approved recovery rehearsal

items.oracle: Real HTTPS has valid login/registration and no mixed-content or browser console/page errors; standard SMTP links use BASE_URL; no NitroSend-specific configuration exists.
At least one authorized external source succeeds; each source status is visible; one failed source does not erase successful results.
Deployment is registered in status and authorized long-term sync reports a real state without creating a second authority.
